scope: real Compute Cluster product top, all seven engines available, shared ai_spad_arbiter and behavioral four-bank SPAD; external DDR AXI timing excluded

staged_three_task.workload: Matrix + CNM in parallel, then SFU

limits: One deterministic workload; all three seeds produced identical benchmark values.
The numbers are VCS RTL cycles under the checked-in behavioral SPAD model, not SRAM timing or ASIC PPA.
No alternate Bank-Aware Issue policy was evaluated; the run proves contention exists but does not prove an optimization benefit.
Per-engine exclusive SPAD stall histograms and external DMA/DDR timing are not included.
